description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 10<sup>3</sup>, with tick labels at 10<sup>0</sup>, 10<sup>1</sup>, 10<sup>2</sup>, and 10<sup>3</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 65, with tick labels at 5-unit intervals.  A black solid line with circular markers represents “Base”, starting at approximately 42% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to approximately 44% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. A brown dashed line with diamond markers represents “MEND”, beginning at approximately 57% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and rising to approximately 55% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. A blue solid line with triangular markers represents “FT”, starting at approximately 43% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to approximately 46% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. A red dashed line with triangular markers represents “IKE”, beginning at approximately 44% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to approximately 48% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. A green solid line with square markers represents “ROME”, starting at approximately 50% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to approximately 62% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. A purple solid line with circular markers represents “MEMIT”, beginning at approximately 52% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to approximately 54% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>.
